description: This PHP source file defines the SaleReturn controller class for an OpenCart extension, responsible for handling sale return reports in the admin interface. It includes methods for displaying the report page, saving settings, generating report data, and listing returns.

classes.name: SaleReturn
classes.description: Controller class for managing the sale return report in the OpenCart admin panel, including view rendering, saving settings, and generating report data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the report page, loads language strings, sets breadcrumbs and headers, and renders the sale return form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of report settings via AJAX, validating permissions, updating settings, and returning success or error messages.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the main report view, including retrieving report data and return statuses, and rendering the report page.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of sale return report data.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates the report data, including filtering, pagination, and formatting, then renders the report list view.
